reason: Does cap8 while any ready decode exists, then full remaining token budget, improve full-request tradeoffs relative to static8 with identical wrapper costs?
telemetry: NVML outside model process every100ms; cgroup CPU counters; all cells same instrumentation
no_metric_reselection: all request latency/ITL/completion and wall retained; no unified SLO selected
resource_boundary: 8 same physical CPU cores in both arms; cannot count improvement over earlier unpinned runs as scheduler gain

phase_policy.phase8: At pre-KV schedule entry: threshold8 while ANY current running request is ready for synchronous decode; otherwise threshold0 (native global token budget64 still applies).
phase_policy.static8: Same wrapper, state checks and logging; threshold8 after action boundary in every call.
phase_policy.enabled_boundary: Existing action key is created only after both original requests have exactly4output tokens.
phase_policy.unsupported: Fail on async, speculative/prefix/preemption state, progress mismatch or any ready decode not scheduled exactly once.

holdout_scope: Same three documents and previously explored action regime; controlled simple-baseline comparison, not independent document holdout.
